title: Two men in El Paso say they are escaped descendants of humans taken off Earth as slaves

tellings.quote: when the ETSs left the earth they took humans with him as slaves.

plain: An Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, passes on a story he credits to a person named Linda Molton How about two men in El Paso, Texas. According to the story, the men say that when extraterrestrials left Earth long ago they took humans with them as slaves, and that the two men are escaped descendants of those people. If true, it would mean humans have been living off Earth for centuries.
